response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong experience with large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure platforms, and technical mentoring, he has a critical gap in the minimum qualification of 8 years C++ programming experience. His professional background is predominantly in TypeScript/Node.js, with only brief C++ exposure (~6-12 months total across National Instruments and a thesis project). For a Technical Lead role on a cloud compute platform where C++ is fundamental, this is a disqualifying factor despite otherwise relevant infrastructure and leadership experience.
strengths: Extensive experience with large-scale distributed systems handling millions of requests/second (Dunnhumby microservices), Kubernetes clusters, and AWS cloud infrastructure through multiple Staff-level roles

Strong track record of technical mentorship and establishing best practices through multiple workshops, code dojos, and peer leadership demonstrating deep expertise in TDD, CI/CD, and trunk-based development

Demonstrated ability to architect and ship complex technical projects from concept to production, including founding GISCollective platform while managing diverse technology choices across multiple domains
concerns: Critical gap in C++ experience: only ~6-12 months across brief roles versus the minimum qualification requirement of 8 years for systems-level programming
Primary technical expertise concentrated in TypeScript/Node.js and web technologies rather than low-level systems programming required for cloud compute platform leadership
Leadership experience appears to be informal peer mentoring at Staff level rather than formal Technical Lead roles with direct responsibility for managing and scaling engineering teams
